energy_page.meta_desc: POLCERO operates its own renewable energy cluster with hydrogen storage at its manufacturing site in Silesia, Poland. Energy independence reduces robot production and AI training costs.
energy_page.hero_h1: Own energy - renewable cluster and hydrogen storage
energy_page.hero_desc: POLCERO operates its own renewable energy cluster with hydrogen storage at its manufacturing site in Silesia, Poland. Energy independence reduces robot production and AI training costs, with surplus available to neighboring facilities.
energy_page.why_title: Energy independence as a competitive foundation
energy_page.why_subtitle: Control over energy is control over cost, compliance and manufacturing continuity.
energy_page.why1_desc: Own renewable generation directly reduces electricity costs for robot manufacturing, electronics assembly and AI model training - without exposure to grid price volatility.
energy_page.why2_desc: Energy self-sufficiency eliminates a key external dependency from our manufacturing supply chain, improving delivery reliability and operational continuity.
energy_page.why3_desc: Our energy setup supports compliance with EU taxonomy, CSRD reporting, and the Machinery Regulation’s carbon-footprint requirements for industrial products.
energy_page.why4_desc: Robots and AI systems built at our site carry a lower embodied-carbon footprint - directly traceable to the renewable source powering their production.
energy_page.cluster_subtitle: A three-element system: generate, buffer, dispatch. Production never stops waiting for the grid.
energy_page.cluster1_desc: Photovoltaic arrays on-site and on adjacent land generate the primary electricity supply for manufacturing and assembly operations.
energy_page.cluster2_desc: Wind turbines supplement solar, improving capacity factor and reducing seasonal dependency on a single renewable source.
energy_page.cluster3_desc: Surplus renewable electricity is converted to hydrogen via electrolysis and stored on-site, enabling dispatch when generation is low - a long-duration buffer for continuous production.
energy_page.benefit1_desc: Renewable self-generation directly reduces the per-robot electricity bill - for electronics fab, assembly lines and AI model fine-tuning compute.
energy_page.benefit2_desc: Hydrogen storage provides a local buffer against grid outages and price spikes, keeping production schedules intact regardless of external events.
energy_page.benefit3_desc: When generation exceeds our own demand, surplus electricity and hydrogen are available to neighboring facilities - contributing to local industrial decarbonization.
energy_page.footprint_desc: Our energy cluster is a backbone branch of the POLCERO group - it exists to make all other branches cheaper, cleaner and more supply-chain resilient. It is not a standalone energy business; it is infrastructure for manufacturing excellence.
energy_page.synergy_title: Energy and manufacturing share the same site
energy_page.synergy_desc: Our energy cluster and robot manufacturing facility are co-located in Kietrz, Silesia. This eliminates transmission losses, simplifies grid connection requirements and keeps both infrastructure layers under direct operational control.
energy_page.cta_desc: Whether you are a potential industrial neighbor, a partner or an investor - contact us to learn more about the POLCERO energy cluster.

manufacturing_page.comp1_desc: PCB design, embedded systems, motor controllers, power electronics and sensor integration - all in-house for full quality control.
manufacturing_page.comp2_desc: Lightweight carbon fiber robot bodies, chassis structures and enclosures. High strength-to-weight ratio, weather-resistant, IP-rated.

manufacturing_page.location_desc: Post-industrial Silesian site with established infrastructure. Full manufacturing and assembly capabilities under one roof. EU-based supply chain, short logistics to Central European markets.

icb_page.meta_title: ICB Robots - Industrial Cobots, Autonomous Forklifts & AMR | POLCERO
icb_page.meta_desc: ICB Robots is POLCERO's established branch for industrial collaborative robots (cobots), autonomous forklifts and AMR platforms. Design, integration and service in Poland and EU - to order.
icb_page.hero_h1: ICB Robots - industrial cobots, autonomous forklifts and AMR platforms
icb_page.hero_h2: Cobots · Autonomous Forklifts · AMR · Control Center · Production Lines
icb_page.specs_title: Real specs from the ICB catalog
icb_page.specs_subtitle: Published specifications from the POLCERO / ICB Robots product line.
icb_page.services_title: Six ways we robotize your operation
icb_page.services_subtitle: Every system is built to the customer's order - matched to process, facility and integration requirements.
icb_page.cases_subtitle: Stages marked as published on the original polcero.com site.
icb_page.industries_subtitle: ICB systems are deployed across manufacturing, logistics and allied sectors - matched to the specific process and facility.
icb_page.workflow_subtitle: Every ICB deployment follows a structured four-step process from documentation to on-site commissioning.
icb_page.brain_title: Every ICB robot runs the POLCERO AI brain
icb_page.brain_desc: All ICB products are powered by the POLCERO AI Systems intelligence layer: VLA vision-language-action models, YOLO-class detection, SLAM navigation and fleet management. The same brain is fine-tuned on your process data. Programming: Python, C++ and ROS.
icb_page.faq1_q: What is a cobot and how is it different from an industrial robot?
icb_page.faq1_a: A cobot (collaborative robot) is designed to work safely alongside human operators without safety cages in certified configurations. It uses force-torque sensing and speed/power limiting to detect contact. Industrial robots typically operate in fenced cells at full speed. ICB cobots comply with ISO 10218 / TS 15066.
icb_page.faq2_q: What is the payload and reach of the ICB AI-controlled robot?
icb_page.faq2_a: The ICB AI-controlled precision assembly robot has a payload of 20 kg, a reach of up to 1,800 mm and a repeatability of ±0.02 mm. It operates in environments from 0 to 45°C and carries a 24-month warranty. Control is via vision + AI (Python, C++, ROS).
icb_page.faq3_q: Do ICB autonomous forklifts require floor markers or infrastructure changes?
icb_page.faq3_a: No. ICB autonomous forklifts use SLAM navigation - they build a map of the facility and navigate without floor stickers, rails or magnets. Minor environmental adjustments (clear aisle widths) may apply.
icb_page.faq4_q: Can ICB robots integrate with our existing WMS or ERP system?
icb_page.faq4_a: Yes. ICB autonomous forklifts and AMR platforms offer REST and MQTT APIs and have been integrated with SAP, Infor and custom WMS/ERP systems. Integration scope is defined during the project documentation phase.
icb_page.faq5_q: Is ICB Robots available as Robot-as-a-Service (RaaS)?
icb_page.faq5_a: Yes. Under RaaS, POLCERO owns, insures and services the robot; the customer pays a periodic fee - no capital expenditure required. Submit an inquiry to discuss the model that fits your operation.
icb_page.related1_tagline: The AI brain for any robot
icb_page.related1_desc: The POLCERO intelligence layer that powers all ICB products - VLA, YOLO, fleet management.
icb_page.related2_desc: The POLCERO modular robot catalog - choose a platform and we integrate the AI brain and task modules.
icb_page.related3_desc: The same AMR platform logic applied to autonomous field robots for vegetable farms.
icb_page.cta_desc: Describe your production line, warehouse or facility challenge - we'll design, build and service an ICB robot or AMR system specifically for your deployment.
icb_page.core_differentiator: Robots already exist - what is missing are the systems that control them. We build that missing layer: we install knowledge, a plan and eyes (cameras, sensors) into the machine, connect it with artificial intelligence and make it work on its own - without a driver and without constant human supervision.
icb_page.faq_prog_q: What programming languages do ICB robots use?
icb_page.faq_prog_a: ICB robots are programmed in Python, C++ and ROS (Robot Operating System). POLCERO handles all programming and integration - the customer does not need to write code.

ai_systems_page.meta_title: AI Systems for Robots - POLCERO AI Brain
ai_systems_page.meta_desc: POLCERO builds the AI intelligence layer for humanoid and specialized robots: VLA fine-tuning, YOLO vision, edge+cloud architecture, fleet management. To order.
ai_systems_page.hero_h1: We build the AI brain for any robot
ai_systems_page.hero_desc: POLCERO builds an AI intelligence layer - perception, planning, control and fleet management - for humanoid and specialized robots. The same AI stack serves all POLCERO branches: fine-tuned VLA models, YOLO vision, edge+cloud architecture and a data flywheel. The robot hardware can be the customer's own or selected from our catalog; we supply the intelligence.
ai_systems_page.layer1_desc: Open VLA models (GR00T N1.7, π0, OpenVLA) fine-tuned on customer-specific data. Abstraction layer allows swapping base models without retraining your task intelligence.
ai_systems_page.layer2_desc: YOLO-class detection for real-time object recognition, depth cameras (RGB-D), LiDAR, multispectral and thermal. System 2 VLM for scene and language understanding.
ai_systems_page.layer3_desc: On-board edge inference for <10ms latency control. Cloud for training updates, analytics, fleet management. Data flywheel continuously improves performance.
ai_systems_page.layer4_desc: PID controllers for simple, repetitive grasping and cutting - lower cost, higher reliability. Reserve AI for complex perception and scene-understanding decisions.

ai_systems_page.faq_title: Common questions about the AI brain
ai_systems_page.faq1_q: What is the POLCERO AI brain?
ai_systems_page.faq1_a: The POLCERO AI brain is an intelligence layer we build for robots - combining VLA (vision-language-action) models fine-tuned on customer data, YOLO-class vision for detection, and fleet management. It runs on the robot's edge compute and connects to cloud for training.
ai_systems_page.faq2_q: Which robots can you add an AI brain to?
ai_systems_page.faq2_a: We can integrate our brain with humanoid robots (Unitree G1/H1/H2, Atlas, Apollo, etc.) or specialized robots. We either integrate with the customer's existing robot, or help select the right platform from our catalog, then fine-tune and deploy.
ai_systems_page.faq3_q: Can a robot replace a construction site manager?
ai_systems_page.faq3_a: A robot with our AI brain can perform many site management tasks: autonomous site walks with 360°/LiDAR capture, BIM comparison, deviation detection, EHS patrols, as-built documentation. Human decision-making remains in the loop for critical judgements.
ai_systems_page.faq4_q: How do you automate trailer unloading?
ai_systems_page.faq4_a: We deploy robots like Boston Dynamics Stretch (mobile case-handler with suction gripper) or humanoids with our AI perception layer for trailer/container unloading. The robot uses computer vision to identify and unload cases 24/7, delivered as Robot-as-a-Service.
ai_systems_page.faq5_a: VLA = vision-language-action. An AI model combining visual perception, language understanding and action planning. POLCERO fine-tunes commercially-licensed VLA models (GR00T N1.7, π0, OpenVLA) on customer-specific data for precise robot control.
ai_systems_page.cta_title: Ready to add AI to your robot?
ai_systems_page.cta_subtitle: We design, fine-tune and deploy - to order.
ai_systems_page.cta_desc: Tell us about your robot and the task. We'll design the AI brain, integrate it, and service it - as a purchase or Robot-as-a-Service.

robots_page.meta_desc: The POLCERO modular robot platform: AI brain, plug-and-play interface, chassis family and task modules. Browse our catalog of robots we deploy with our AI brain - for any market, to order.
robots_page.hero_h1: One platform - any market, any robot
robots_page.hero_h2: AI brain · Plug-and-play interface · Chassis family · Task modules
robots_page.hero_desc: The POLCERO Robots branch is the modular platform at the core of everything we build - a shared AI brain, standardised interface, interchangeable chassis and plug-and-play task modules. We also deploy robots from our partner catalog, layering our AI brain on top for any market.
robots_page.platform_subtitle: Every POLCERO robot is built from the same four interchangeable layers. The IP is in the data, fine-tuning and fleet logic - not in any single component.
robots_page.layer1_desc: VLA + YOLO models fine-tuned on customer data. Edge inference + cloud training. The same intelligence layer adapts to every chassis and market - perception, planning, task execution and fleet management.
robots_page.layer2_desc: Standardised mechanical and electrical connector. Swap chassis or task modules without redesigning the intelligence layer. One integration point for all combinations.
robots_page.layer3_desc: W4 (wheeled), T6 (tracked), WL4 (wheel-leg), Q4 (quadruped). Wheeled platforms are ~2.5× more energy-efficient than legged on flat ground - matched to terrain and task.
robots_page.layer4_desc: Soft gripper, spray/fertigation head, sensor mast (RGB-D / multispectral / thermal), logistics carrier, remote manipulator - plug in the right tool for the job.
robots_page.energy_desc: Wheeled platforms are approximately 2.5× more energy-efficient than legged robots on flat ground - we always recommend the most efficient chassis for the terrain. All platforms use LFP (lithium iron phosphate) battery chemistry. Energy modes: grid-connected, trolley + buffer, or hot-swap battery packs for continuous 24/7 operation.
robots_page.build_subtitle: We build specialized robots for specific markets and missions. Every system is designed and manufactured after a customer inquiry - nothing off the shelf.
robots_page.spec1_desc: Autonomous field platforms for planting, care, precision spray and selective harvest. Sensor fusion: RGB-D + multispectral + thermal for crop health monitoring.
robots_page.spec2_desc: BIM-to-field layout, overhead drilling, autonomous earthworks, inspection vs digital twin. Human-supervised autonomy throughout.
robots_page.spec3_desc: 24/7 autonomous patrol of facilities, critical infrastructure and perimeters. RGB-D + thermal imaging, anomaly detection, remote reporting. Human-in-the-loop for all actions.
robots_page.spec4_desc: Quadruped and tracked platforms for reconnaissance, infrastructure protection and humanitarian demining - see Commander branch. All within EU dual-use export-control frameworks.
robots_page.spec5_desc: Fixed-arm robots and intelligent workstations for inspection, quality control, repetitive assembly and material handling on production lines.
robots_page.spec6_desc: Vision and R&D direction: a general-purpose utility robot combining POLCERO chassis, AI brain and multi-purpose gripper for light service, logistics and research applications.

robots_page.catalog_subtitle: We integrate our AI brain on top of best-in-class robot hardware from our partner catalog - fleet management, task intelligence and deployment included.
robots_page.catalog_more: The catalog grows continuously. Don't see the robot you need?

farma_ai_page.meta_title: Farma AI - Agriculture Robots & AI-Farmer System | POLCERO
farma_ai_page.meta_desc: POLCERO Farma AI: autonomous field robots with AI-farmer brain for planting, care, spot spraying and selective harvest of vegetables. Robot-as-a-Service model. Made in Poland.
farma_ai_page.hero_h1: Autonomous field robots with an AI-farmer brain
farma_ai_page.hero_h2: Planting · Care · Selective harvest - to order
farma_ai_page.hero_desc: Farma AI is POLCERO's agriculture branch: a fleet of autonomous field robots controlled by the 'AI-farmer' supervisory brain for the full crop cycle - planting, care (weeding, spot spraying), monitoring and selective harvest of delicate vegetables. Designed for large vegetable farms, delivered as Robot-as-a-Service (RaaS) - no capital expenditure.
farma_ai_page.cycle_subtitle: From planting to harvest, one robot fleet handles the whole season.
farma_ai_page.crop1_desc: Precise row-by-row transplanting or direct seeding with RTK/SLAM navigation. Sub-centimeter placement accuracy on the POLCERO-W4 chassis.
farma_ai_page.crop2_desc: Computer-vision weed detection + mechanical or thermal weeding. No herbicide for identified weeds - only targeted spot spray.
farma_ai_page.crop3_desc: Selective application of fertilizer or plant-protection products only where the AI detects need. Reduces chemical use by up to 90% vs. blanket spraying.
farma_ai_page.crop4_desc: Daily field scanning with RGB-D + multispectral + thermal cameras. Crop health map, disease early-warning, harvest readiness prediction.
farma_ai_page.crop5_desc: Selective harvesting of delicate vegetables (starting with lettuce heads) - the hardest unsolved gap in agri automation. Soft gripper + AI maturity detection.
farma_ai_page.innov_title: Why selective harvest is the last frontier
farma_ai_page.innov_p1: Weeding, thinning and baby-leaf harvest are already commercial. Selective harvesting of individual lettuce heads - identifying the right maturity level, soft-grasping without damage, at field speed - is the unsolved gap we target. Combined with the full cycle integration (planting → care → harvest), this is where POLCERO's AI-farmer system creates durable competitive advantage.
farma_ai_page.innov_p2: Perception: RGB-D + multispectral + thermal cameras. Maturity model: YOLO + fine-tuned VLA on crop-specific datasets. Gripper: soft pneumatic with adaptive force control. Navigation: RTK/SLAM for sub-centimeter row-level precision.
farma_ai_page.tech2_i3: Multi-variant: grid in greenhouse / trolley+buffer in field
farma_ai_page.tech3_i1: POLCERO-W4 (flat fields, ~2.5× more efficient than legs)
farma_ai_page.tech3_i3: Interchangeable task modules per crop phase
farma_ai_page.value1_desc: Spot spraying only where needed - up to 90% less plant-protection product vs. blanket application.
farma_ai_page.value2_desc: AI selects the right maturity window - less waste, higher quality, consistent throughput.

photonic_page.meta_title: Photonic Processors - AI Compute with Light | POLCERO R&D
photonic_page.meta_desc: POLCERO's R&D direction: photonic computing for accelerating AI inference in robots. Optical matrix multiplication, sub-nanosecond latency, orders-of-magnitude lower energy than GPU/ASIC.
photonic_page.hero_h1: Photonic computing for robot AI - beyond electronics
photonic_page.hero_h2: Light-speed inference · Lower power · Higher throughput
photonic_page.hero_desc: Photonic Processors is POLCERO's R&D direction for accelerating AI inference in our robots using light instead of electronics alone. Optical matrix multiplication - the core operation in neural networks - can be performed in a single optical pass through photonic chips, delivering sub-nanosecond latency and orders-of-magnitude lower energy per operation compared to GPU/ASIC chips.
photonic_page.hero_honest: Honest positioning: This is an R&D direction and vision - not a finished product. POLCERO tracks the photonic AI computing space as a future compute layer for our robots' AI brains. We engage in R&D projects and partnerships in this area.
photonic_page.tech_subtitle: Processing information with light rather than electrons alone.
photonic_page.tech1_desc: Neural network inference is dominated by matrix-vector multiplication (GEMM). Photonic chips perform this operation using light passing through Mach-Zehnder interferometer meshes, microring resonators or beam-splitter arrays - executing in a single optical pass what electronic chips require thousands of clock cycles to compute.
photonic_page.tech2_desc: Photonic chips excel at linear operations (matrix math) but cannot natively perform nonlinear operations (activation functions). The consensus architecture combines optical cores for matrix math with electronic units for nonlinear activations and accumulation - a hybrid design that captures the best of both technologies.
photonic_page.bench_subtitle: Key properties - data from published research, validated benchmarks, as of 2025–2026.
photonic_page.sota_subtitle: Matter-of-fact overview - data as of research date, subject to change.
photonic_page.market_desc: Global photonic AI accelerator chip market, 2025 → 2034 (CAGR 26.3%). 52 photonic computing companies tracked globally as of 2026.
photonic_page.direction_title: Photonics as the future compute layer for robot AI
photonic_page.direction_desc: As photonic inference accelerators reach commercial maturity (2027–2031 timeframe for datacenter-class products), POLCERO's AI-brain architecture is designed to absorb them - the model abstraction layer allows swapping the compute substrate without retraining the task intelligence. We engage in R&D projects and partnerships to evaluate photonic chips as the compute layer for edge inference in our robots - where power and latency are the binding constraints.
photonic_page.cta_subtitle: We engage in R&D projects and partnerships.
photonic_page.cta_desc: If you work in photonic AI, silicon photonics or adjacent compute technology, reach out to discuss research collaboration or pilot projects.
